title: A representable morphism is universally submersive exactly when all its base changes are submersive on spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterises representable morphisms of algebraic stacks which are universally submersive as those whose every base change induces a submersive map on topological spaces (author lemma at source lines 2564-2576, label lemma-characterize-representable-universally-submersive). The proof (source lines 2578-2601) proves the non-trivial direction by choosing a smooth scheme cover of the test stack, where the base change is submersive by hypothesis, and descending submersiveness along the comparison square whose horizontal arrows are open and surjective and whose induced map to the fibre product of spaces is surjective (proof lines 2579-2599); the converse is recorded as following from the definitions. The descent along the comparison square is the content. H2.
